ai.title: Process stream emits end tag on EOF
ai.summary: EOF handling in processStreamWithTags now synthesizes closing tag events instead of yielding raw buffer. Remaining content is stripped of STOP_MARKER, passed to onTagEnd, and state reset. Affects backend/src/process-stream.ts.

eli5.text: If a stream of content stops unexpectedly in the middle of a tagged section, the system now cleanly closes that section by emitting an end tag, rather than leaving incomplete content in the buffer. Previously, leftover content would remain unresolved, potentially causing confusion or data mishandling. This ensures that any partial data received before an abrupt stop is properly processed and the system state is reset for subsequent operations. The updated process stream now strips internal stop markers and validates remaining content before finalizing the tag closure.

ai.title: Update large file token limit and add manifold submodule
ai.summary: Refined large file detection in `backend/src/process-file-block.ts` by summing initial content and edit snippet tokens, raising `LARGE_FILE_TOKEN_LIMIT` from 10,000 to 11,000. Added `strange-loop/manifold` as a new git submodule. Changes affect backend file processing logic and repo structure.

eli5.text: The assistant now treats bigger files as normal instead of flagging them, so longer documents you send in will be handled the full way without getting cut off as "too large." When checking size, the system now adds together both the original content and the new edit you made, and the cutoff moved from 10,000 to 11,000 tokens. A new piece of extra code from the manifold project was also pulled into the repository. If you looked at your work on GitHub today, you'd see the file-size rule relaxed and a new submodule folder added.
